# New bench rows no longer publish a reply prefix
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #368, sha256:dc6e3141a65020aa3b26ce06ca7845317c7d618dae6aefaa115c9bf76213e673). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Draft
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** story
- **Repository:** avowry (the bench history writer, bench history files)
- **Source:** product-owner answers to the nine owner items on docs/release/pre-publication-checks.md, inbox entry of 2026-11-08 (card 186). Ranked before the v0.1 publish card.
- **Depends on:** none
- **Story:** As Dana, I want new bench rows to leave out the reply prefix, so that the history I read does not publish model output.
- **Consumer value:** Dana reads bench history that carries results without any model reply text.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Scenario: [O][S] a new row has no prefix
     Given the bench writes a new row
     When the row is saved
     Then it carries no reply_head text (the field is absent or empty), and every other field is unchanged
  2. Scenario: [Z][E] old rows stay
     Given rows already pushed
     When the writer changes
     Then the pushed rows are untouched and still read by the same tools
  3. Scenario: [I] a guard
     Given the writer
     When a test writes a row with a long reply
     Then the saved row holds no part of the reply
- **Not in this card:** Rewriting or deleting pushed rows (the history stays public).
- **Size:** S
